question: LIMBUA company founded year founding location and headquarters address
markdown:
The German-Kenyan organic farming company
⁠LIMBUA
was founded in 2009. Its founding roots span Germany and Kenya (with its first processing facility set up in Githure, Kenya), and its corporate headquarters is located at Raunerweg 13, 82211 Herrsching am Ammersee, Bavaria, Germany.
Company Details
Founded Year:
2009
Founding / Operational Locations:
Germany and Kenya (processing plant in Githure; Kenyan office in Embu)
Headquarters Address:
Raunerweg 13, 82211 Herrsching am Ammersee, Bavaria, Germany
